# Load

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(janitor)
library(endest)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(edgeR)
library(DMRcate)
select <- dplyr::select
rename <- dplyr::rename
```

```{r}
GSE223817_pdata <- readRDS(here("data/GSE223817_pdata.rds"))
GSE223817_m_values <- readRDS(here("data/GSE223817_m.rds"))
```

```{r}
GSE234354_phenotype <- readRDS(here("data/GSE234354_phenotype.rds"))
GSE234354_counts <- readRDS(here("data/GSE234354_counts.rds"))
```

```{r}
rwh_phenotype_info <- read.table(here("data/rwh_phenotype_info.tsv"), sep="\t",
                                 header=TRUE) %>%
  mutate(plate=as.character(plate),
         sentrix_id=as.character(sentrix_id))
```

-----

# Tidy GSE223817 pdata

```{r}
methyl_sample_info <- GSE223817_pdata %>% clean_names()
methyl_sample_info <- methyl_sample_info %>% select(geo_accession, batch_ch1:terminus_ch1)
colnames(methyl_sample_info) <- str_remove(colnames(methyl_sample_info), "_ch1$")
methyl_sample_info <- methyl_sample_info %>% select(-sample_type, -gender)
```

```{r}
methyl_sample_info
```


-----

# Merge metadata from GEO with RWH data

```{r}
methyl_phenotype <- full_join(methyl_sample_info, rwh_phenotype_info, by=join_by(sentrix_id, terminus, plate))
```

```{r}
methyl_phenotype
```

-----

# Estimate cycle time for RNA-seq data

```{r}
endest_results <- estimate_cycle_time(GSE234354_counts)
```


```{r}
methyl_phenotype <- methyl_phenotype %>%
  mutate(time=endest_results$estimated_time[sample_id]) %>%
  select(geo_accession:sample_id, time, everything())
```

-----

# Get gene annotations

```{r}
y <- DGEList(GSE234354_counts)
y <- calcNormFactors(y)
ok <- rowMeans(cpm(y) > 0.5) > 0.2
table(ok)
```

```{r}
y <- y[ok, , keep.lib.sizes=FALSE]
```

```{r}
# Get Ensembl IDs in expression data
ensembl_ids <- rownames(y)
length(ensembl_ids)

# Get gene info from org.Hs.eg.db
# columns(org.Hs.eg.db)
cols <- c("SYMBOL", "ENTREZID", "GENENAME")
annotation <- AnnotationDbi::select(org.Hs.eg.db, keys=ensembl_ids, columns=cols, keytype="ENSEMBL")
```

```{r}
# Remove genes without symbols
annotation <- annotation %>% filter(! is.na(annotation$SYMBOL))
dim(annotation)

# Show duplicates
# annotation %>% filter(ENSEMBL %in% annotation[duplicated(annotation$ENSEMBL),"ENSEMBL"])

# Take the first row if duplicate annotations
annotation <- annotation[!duplicated(annotation$ENSEMBL),]
dim(annotation)
```

```{r}
annotation <- annotation %>% clean_names() %>%
  rename(ensembl_id="ensembl",
         entrez_id="entrezid",
         gene_name="genename")
```

-----

# Subset RWH M values

Save the smaller matrix of RWH samples with RNA-seq data and filtered probes
to save memory when loading in data in downstream analyses.

```{r}
rwh_subset <- methyl_phenotype %>% filter(! is.na(sample_id))
rwh_m_values <- rmSNPandCH(GSE223817_m_values[,rwh_subset$geo_accession])
```

```{r}
dim(rwh_m_values)
```


-----

# Save data

```{r}
saveRDS(methyl_phenotype, file=here("data/methyl_phenotype.rds"))
saveRDS(annotation, file=here("data/GSE234354_gene_annotations.rds"))
saveRDS(rwh_m_values, file=here("cache/rwh_m_values.rds"))
```
